clusters.attribution: All three PRs and their merge-commit authors are steipete/Peter Steinberger. Creation and merge events are in this window, not republished old proposals. Contribution is public-project evidence, not an employer roadmap.

oc174134: Main-session startup recovery now awaits a deferred resolved after subagent restoration settles. The promise also resolves on failure; this is a dependency-settlement gate, not proof restoration succeeded.

Worker discovery applies existing recovery-claim predicate before transferring selected rows. Archived/tombstoned/no-obligation rows are excluded; completed rows with delivery/recovery custody remain. Incognito memory sessions have no durable restart selection. Separate reader/delivery/activation spans improve diagnostics.

Changed tests use deferred activation success/failure, real session-store selection and both removed/retained consumed-input representations. The worker regression expects5relevant rows out of10. Entire12changed patches read; no upstream execution.
oc174177: Restoration owner distinguishes missing/mismatched original evidence or explicit current access denial from overload and unavailable access-policy startup. It records permanent reasons, preserves restricted custody and retries designated transient failures.

Exact cohort settlement uses existing batch mutation. operator_authority_unavailable clears the old requester wake and suppresses fallback system notices while retaining child outcomes. Missing cohort can return undefined only after exact/binding checks; an existing unbound cohort throws and stays retryable.

Main recovery writes an idempotent local interruption notice and clears old claims through guarded transcript/lifecycle update. A saved replayable reply is sanitized and included as delivery-unconfirmed. New pendingFinalDelivery expectation uses deep equality, fencing a concurrent replacement intent. Startup marking respects terminal run fences instead of rearming solely because status remains interrupted.

Changed tests include same-process lifecycle rotation/SQLite reload with mocked recovery runtime, explicit pre-binding refusal and unavailable-policy retry, one terminal notice across another simulated boot, preserved workspace/reply, cohort-result preservation and no system event, concurrent pending-final replacement, plus Gateway admission harness changes with agentCommandMock. These sources are not independent OS-crash proof. Entire15changed patches read.
oc174203: The sole changed source patch reconciles orphaned receiver custody through existing session-recovery owner after authorization and before a non-restart admission touches/replaces its row. It passes current-request commit guard and worker-placement context, then asserts current request again.
No tests change in this commit. Real restart/five-delivery/second-restart claims come from author-reported unchanged tests, not an execution or full test-file read by this audit.

next_falsifiable_gate.pin: Actual packaged Gateway/dependencies at one frozen tree after all3merges plus authentic adjacent parents, especially174134 parent versus head and174203 follow-up. Preserve exact config/model/policy.
next_falsifiable_gate.design: Start saved peer delivery before registry activation; separately hold activation, fail it, inject worker overload and temporarily unavailable policy. With identical saved session/cohort/receipt identities, compare transient recovery versus missing/mismatched source/explicit grant denial. Include authorized healthy control, cancelled/consumed/reset/revoked controls, replacement pending-final intent during guarded transcript append, and actual two process restarts.
next_falsifiable_gate.receipts: Independent PID/physical-exit/SQLite/sourceRun/lifecycle/incarnation/current device-role authority, exact pending input/receipt/notice identity, provider transport and durable effect records. Five authorized updates arrive once in order, with no forbidden effect; permanent old input settles once preserving child results/saved reply; transient failure retains uncharged custody and later recovers.
next_falsifiable_gate.falsifiers: Transient binding/policy failure being terminally dropped, repeated permanent wake/notice after second boot, stale cohort authority or widened system fallback, overwritten replacement intent, missing/duplicate/out-of-order effect or any revoked effect fails. Combine earlier4-wide progress gate, long checkpoint-tail, requested-kill/pre-settlement crash and exact receipt gates; do not claim either is solved by unchanged files.

sources.title: fix(coding-agent): remove fixed output limits from summary requests

clusters.attribution: Actual PR/commit author is davidbrai/David Brailovsky, not watchlist author badlogic/Mario Zechner. This is ecosystem evidence. Proposal and merge are both in window.
source_facts: Compaction, turn-prefix and branch-summary code stops supplying fixed maxTokens. Old0.8*reserveTokens/0.5*reserveTokens/4096caps are removed. generateSummary/generateSummaryWithUsage keep the old positional reserveTokens argument for callers but ignore it; internal calls pass undefined.

Docs redefine reserveTokens as the compaction trigger reserve. Thinking level/routing/request options remain, but old tests asserting local output caps are removed or revised. Split-turn usage aggregation assertion stays. Entire9changed patches read.

The changed patch does not implement provider sizing. A comment/docs say provider handles actual-request/model-output/context sizing, but exact provider implementations and actual wire requests were not audited here. No new fake-provider cap-omission assertion or provider-limit integration proof is introduced in the read patch.
clusters.author_claims_not_independently_verified: PR says reasoning consumes shared output cap on OpenAI Responses/adaptive Anthropic, causing token-cap failures despite larger model capacity; actual summary requests omit recent messages, normal system/tools and may be smaller, so existing provider sizing should handle them. No independent provider run, token/cost/quality/recall benchmark here.

ci_metadata.scope: Run API metadata on prepared PR head, not independently executed tests or exact merge proof. Success/skipped records remain separate.

clusters.our_inference: Trigger policy and actual summary-generation budget now have different owners. H2 policy snapshots and H4 environment/reward replay need actual routed model and wire-level limits, rather than assuming reserveTokens defines output. More output allowance can change cost and context safety; neither benefit nor regression was measured here.

next_falsifiable_gate.pin: Authentic parent/head of6fcb48670fc0e6672a644f3b2691010321734426 with exact provider implementation, model/context/output limits, thinking and request shape. No paid API jobs authorized by this source audit.
next_falsifiable_gate.design: Same histories and manual/automatic/overflow/branch/split-turn cases; vary reserve trigger independently from reasoning/model output/context limits, including routing/model switch, zero or unknown maxTokens, near-full input, cancellation and truncation. First inspect actual provider paths and local wire receipts before any later authorized model experiment.
next_falsifiable_gate.receipts: Resolved model and policy snapshots, exact outgoing max/output/context fields, reason/summary tokens, stop reason, input hashes, usage/cost/latency and post-summary context size. Keep deterministic assertion and genuine provider proof separate.
next_falsifiable_gate.falsifiers: Context overflow, zero/unknown cap mis-sizing, routing to an unintended model, silent truncated summary, altered retry/restart policy or worse fixed-task summary/recall under matched budget rejects the expected benefit. H4 real pinned Pi/ACP/MCP two-segment replay and reward-version gates remain unmet.
